verdict.rationale: llamafile is a local LLM server, so loading and switching models at runtime is a fair question. The evidence never documents multi-model loading or hot-swapping. The docs describe one bundled model per self-contained file, and a community comment calls it 'a binary that only runs one model with one set of weights', which matches the absence of the capability rather than contradicting any vendor claim.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server
